title: Induced subdivisions of $K_{d+1}$ in graphs of high girth
summary: In this paper, we show that for all $k\geq 10^8$, every graph with minimum degree $k$ and girth at least $10^8$ contains an induced subdivision of a $K_{k+1}$. This answers a problem asked by Kühn and Osthus (originally attributed to Shi).
